title: Canonical tensor-single and inverse-image comparisons
statement: For a Grothendieck abelian braided closed monoidal category C with functorial flat resolutions, define tensorSingleRepresentative M P to be the lax tensorator of Q at P and single M followed by Q of the total-tensor/single-complex isomorphism. For a commutative ring A, f:Z -> W and a specified iso k:f^{-1}M ~= N, define upperStarSingleCoefficientIso to be the exact-derived inverse-image comparison followed by the single-functor comparison and the single image of k. Define upperStarTensorSingleIso to have component at X the ordinary oplax tensor comparison f^{-1}(X tensor M) ~= f^{-1}X tensor f^{-1}M followed by tensoring with k. These are exactly the existing constructions formerly declared in UpperStarSingleTensorRepresentative, with unchanged signatures and bodies.

source.place: Tags 0G7E and 07A4; unchanged canonical single-complex comparisons.

proof.text: The first two maps are the specified composites. The third is a natural isomorphism because ordinary inverse image is strong monoidal. Its naturality follows from δ_natural_left and whisker_exchange. This preserves the original construction and its naturality proof verbatim; only its file changes.
